Rajasthan Public Service Commission (RPSC) has released the advertisement for School Lecturer PGT Teacher Exam 2025.

About the Programme

The Rajasthan RPSC School Lecturer PGT Teacher Recruitment 2025 is a government job opportunity for Master Degree holders in related subjects. The programme aims to recruit 3225 candidates for the post of School Lecturer PGT Teacher in Rajasthan.
The programme is open to candidates who have a Master Degree in related subjects with a Degree or Diploma in Education (B.Ed / DELEd).
